title: Entry transclusion completion states (owner steer §16)
description: The 12 completion states of one p/v/n entry as a first-class knowledge node. States form an ordered ladder; a report is HONEST by construction: every reached state must cite evidence addresses in committed artifacts, current_state is the highest state whose whole prefix is reached, and certification-dependent states may never be claimed from candidate-only artifacts. Extends the existing ontology (qamus.graph_edge.v1 vocabulary, particle-edge-ontology extension) — state names refer to those edge kinds and never introduce a parallel vocabulary. Producer: tools/build_entry_completion_state.py. Gated in tools/check_regressions.py via tools/test_entry_transclusion_invariants.py.

generated_from.description: Committed artifact paths this report was computed from.

state_id.description: The 12 completion states, in ladder order. 1-4 are entry-store facts; 5 is the root-family relation (root sharing NEVER entails entry identity); 6-8 are the occurrence transclusion ladder with structural candidate/certified separation; 9-10 are the public projection/appearance and reverse-listing states; 11 is teaching-asset derivation (rules/drills citing certified occurrences); 12 is full transclusion closure.

evidence.description: REQUIRED (non-empty) whenever reached is true — a reached state without evidence is dishonest and must fail validation.

entry_kind.description: p = particle, v = verb, n = noun — every kind is a first-class knowledge node with the same state ladder.

honest.description: Structural honesty marker: must be literally true; the builder emits the CURRENT state, never the aspirational one.

states.description: Exactly the 12 ladder states, in ladder order.

current_state.description: The highest state whose entire ladder prefix is reached.

blockers.description: What honestly prevents the next state (free text, e.g. 'occurrence links are candidate-only; certification requires the two-vote rung').
